profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company headquartered in Dublin, trading under the ticker ACN. On its own site, the company describes itself as embracing the power of change to create what it calls 360° value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, and says it is creating better experiences for people using emerging technologies and human ingenuity across industries and around the world.

The site material centers on AI. Accenture describes Accenture Construct as a new global business bringing together advisory, engineering, delivery, digital and AI to orchestrate capital projects from strategy through execution and operation. It also points to work helping leaders redesign work, accelerate skills and reinvent HR so people and AI work together, framed as the Human + AI era. Other site content addresses the state of enterprise AI adoption, power demand for data centers that the company says is pushing beyond grid limits, and cyber resilience in what it describes as an AI driven threat landscape.

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company. Its registration details list CIK 0001467373 and headquarters in Dublin.
